title: 第3章  广积粮缓称王第4章  大恩不言谢
content_zh:
但今天白天发生的事情，让他清楚知道，这一块来往的行人并不多！
他无法通过收取住宿费赚取太多的诡石，要想活的足够久，必须通过击杀诡物来获取「诡石」。
不能坐吃山空。
他需要一个稳定的收入来源！
下一刻——
他手臂刺入「诡火」那滚烫火焰里，诡异的是他的皮肤乃至衣物却没有一丝受损，从火堆里取出一枚完整的诡石，连同掌心里这枚刚刚收获的诡石握在一起，缓缓闭上双眼。
紧接着！
在瘸猴难以置信的眼神中，他手里的两枚诡石开始快速融化，化成乳白色液体从指缝流出，尚未落至地面，便幻做数十条虚幻白线漂浮半空中，开始有规律的组成，并渐渐凝固。
数秒后。
一个「钢制捕兽夹」从空中掉落在地面上。
这是他消耗了2枚诡石，刚刚打造出来的1级捕兽夹陷阱，可对低等级诡物造成伤害，以此来源源不断的为他获取诡石！
“成了。”
陈凡站在原地，望向地面上那个看起来极其简易的捕兽夹笑了起来，突然穿越到这个危险且未知的世界所带来的紧张、恐惧、茫然等复杂情绪，在这一瞬间消散了不少。
至少...有了希望。
不再绝望。
“少爷！”
亲眼目睹了这一切的瘸猴，此时整个人脸颊泛白情绪异常激动，但看了眼木屋又强行压低声音，颤声道：“少爷，你竟然觉醒成建筑师了！”
“而且第一次尝试建筑，竟然就成功了！”
“只要让老爷知道这个消息，少爷你立马可以回到家族，享受最好的待遇，再也没人可以欺负少爷你了。”
“老爷肯定会为你这些年所遭不公做主的！”

“不了。”
陈凡眼中闪烁着光芒轻笑了起来：“我不太喜欢别人为我做主。”
...
数百年前，永夜降临。
世界秩序瞬间崩塌，无数人惨遭「诡物」之手，尸横遍野，但在无数条性命的摸索之下，人们慢慢发现了活下去的办法。
只要吸收一枚「诡石」。
便可增强身体素质，甚至可以学习法术，来以此对抗诡物，宛如仙人一般。
这些人也被通称为「修行者」。
只是——
在这个世界上，躲藏是主流生存方式，哪怕再强大的「修行者」也不可能在黑暗里对抗如潮水般源源不断的诡物，若永夜降临不靠近「诡火」，哪怕实力足够强大，也会被耗死。
而少部分幸运儿。
在吸收了一枚「诡石」后，则会成为特殊的修行者，这些修行者往往拥有颇为特殊的能力。
比如「夜行者」，在永夜降临后依旧能拥有一定视野范围。
又比如「炼丹师」，可以用诡物的尸体辅于天地灵草制造出拥有多种神奇效果的丹药。
相比普通修行者，类似「夜行者」「炼丹师」这些特殊修行者要更加强大，拥有更多手段，随便去一个势力都是座上宾，若是愿意签下契约加入，每月会获得大量俸禄。
而在这些特殊修行者里，其中一种特殊修行者地位是最高的，也是最为稀少的，那便是...「建筑师」！
content_en:
But what happened during the day made him clearly aware that there were not many pedestrians coming and going in this area!
He cannot earn too many rocks by charging accommodation fees. If he wants to survive long enough, he must obtain "bricks" by killing monsters.
You can't just sit back and have nothing.
He needs a steady source of income!
The next moment——
His arm was pierced into the hot flames of the "Weird Fire". Strangely, his skin and even his clothes were not damaged at all. He took out a complete strange stone from the fire, held it together with the newly harvested strange stone in his palm, and slowly closed his eyes.
Next!
In the lame monkey's disbelieving eyes, the two treacherous stones in his hand began to melt rapidly, turning into milky white liquid and flowing out from between his fingers. Before it fell to the ground, it turned into dozens of illusory white lines floating in the air, began to form regularly, and gradually solidified.
After a few seconds.
A "steel bear trap" fell from the air to the ground.
This is a level 1 bear trap that he just built after consuming 2 guile stones. It can cause damage to low-level treacherous objects, and in this way, he can continuously obtain guile stones for him!
"It's done."
Chen Fan stood there, looking at the extremely simple-looking animal trap on the ground and laughed. The nervousness, fear, confusion and other complex emotions caused by suddenly traveling into this dangerous and unknown world dissipated a lot in this moment.
At least... there is hope.
No more despair.
"Master!"
Lame Monkey, who had witnessed all this with his own eyes, turned pale and was very excited. However, he glanced at the wooden house and lowered his voice, trembling: "Master, you have awakened to become an architect!"
“And the first time I tried building, I succeeded!”
"As long as the master knows the news, young master, you can return to the family immediately and enjoy the best treatment. No one can bully you, young master."
"The master will definitely make the decision for the injustice you have suffered over the years!"
"No."
Chen Fan's eyes flashed and he chuckled: "I don't like others to make decisions for me."
...
Hundreds of years ago, eternal night fell.
The world order collapsed instantly, countless people were brutally killed by "strange things", and corpses littered the fields. However, after countless lives were groped, people slowly found a way to survive.
Just absorb one "rock".
You can enhance your physical fitness and even learn spells to fight against strange things, just like an immortal.
These people are also commonly known as "practitioners."
Just——
In this world, hiding is the mainstream way of survival. No matter how powerful the "practitioner" is, it is impossible to fight against the endless tide of strange things in the dark. If the eternal night falls and you don't get close to the "strange fire", even if you are strong enough, you will be consumed to death.
And a few lucky ones.
After absorbing a "guilty stone", you will become a special practitioner, and these practitioners often have quite special abilities.
For example, "Night Walker" can still have a certain range of vision after the eternal night falls.
Another example is the "alchemist" who can use the corpses of strange objects and the spiritual herbs of heaven and earth to create elixirs with a variety of magical effects.
Compared with ordinary practitioners, special practitioners such as "Night Walkers" and "Alchemists" are more powerful and have more means. They are guests of any force they go to. If they are willing to sign a contract to join, they will receive a large salary every month.
Among these special practitioners, one type of special practitioner has the highest status and is also the rarest, and that is... "Architect"!
